execution.state_issue: The check only verifies if the caller's origin matches the contract's owner, which may not be sufficient.
execution.exploitable_behavior: An attacker can send transactions to any receiver without needing to be the owner.

causality.state: The 'owner' variable holds the address of the deploying sender instead of the caller when called externally.
causality.transition: The check doesn't restrict external callers from sending transactions.
causality.capability: An attacker can exploit this by calling `sendTo` with any receiver without being the owner.
causality.outcome: Funds can be transferred to unintended parties.
